warnings.message: SfM tracking quality is WEAK: 24/145 keyframes registered in the largest connected model; the trajectory covers only part of the walkthrough.
SfM produced 6 disconnected models (sizes [24, 23, 17, 16, 14]); only the largest is used, so the rest of the video is not reconstructed.
Camera intrinsics were estimated by COLMAP (SIMPLE_RADIAL, shared by all keyframes); no focal-length metadata was used.
Video tier: metres come from a monocular metric-depth model calibrated against SfM; dimensions carry a relative 1-sigma of about 14% (scale 10%, SfM 10%, depth 3%) and are less certain than LiDAR.
No closed rooms were recovered; only structural wall segments are reported.
1 structural walls do not form any closed room.
Opening recall has not been verified: openings in walls that were not detected, or in unclosed regions, are not reported.
No physical ground truth was supplied: dimensions are not benchmarked, and intervals are diagnostic uncertainty ranges, not calibrated confidence intervals.
Tracking is weak, so the property is reported as partial.
Gravity (vertical) confidence is low, so floor/ceiling/wall geometry may be tilted.
Damage analysis is deterministic image processing (cracks, stains) on RGB evidence: detections are candidates, not verified defects, and no ground truth was available to measure precision or recall.
